about: Gas stations the team has checked on the ground that OpenStreetMap does not have yet. scripts/fetch-fuel.mjs merges these into fuel-stations.json (a station already in OpenStreetMap within 40 m, same brand, is kept once). Better still: add the station to OpenStreetMap with the Every Door or StreetComplete phone app, so every map gets it, then re-run the script and delete it here.
rules: Only positions you measured yourself: stand at the station's entrance and read your phone's GPS (Every Door, the CommuteAI tracker, or any GPS app). Never copy a position or details from Google Maps or another map: their terms forbid it, and it would make this data unusable.
